---
title: "table1viz in Word"
format: docx
---

<!--
Manual check of table1viz() Word output: render with
  quarto render inst/quarto/table1viz-word.qmd
from the package root and open the .docx. Each table should be a native,
editable Word table with the graphics drawn as vector shapes in the cells.
Loads the development version of the package from the source tree (two
levels up from this file).
-->

```{r}
#| include: false
devtools::load_all("../..", quiet = TRUE)
set.seed(1)
df <- data.frame(
  grp = sample(c("A", "B", "C"), 200, TRUE),
  age = rnorm(200, 60, 15),
  los = rlnorm(200, 5, 0.8),
  sex = sample(c("Female", "Male"), 200, TRUE),
  diabetes = rbinom(200, 1, 0.4)
)
df_miss <- df
df_miss$los[sample(200, 30)] <- NA
df_miss$sex[sample(200, 12)] <- NA
```

## By group (combined layout), defaults

```{r}
#| echo: false
table1viz(df_miss, name_groupvar = "grp")
```

## By group, graphics in each column

```{r}
#| echo: false
table1viz(df_miss, name_groupvar = "grp", plot_layout = "columns")
```

## Whole cohort

```{r}
#| echo: false
table1viz(df_miss)
```

## Variable dividers and bar axes (combined layout)

```{r}
#| echo: false
table1viz(
  df_miss,
  name_groupvar = "grp",
  variable_divider = TRUE,
  bar_axis = TRUE
)
```

## Variable dividers and bar axes (columns layout)

```{r}
#| echo: false
table1viz(
  df_miss,
  name_groupvar = "grp",
  plot_layout = "columns",
  variable_divider = TRUE,
  bar_axis = TRUE
)
```

## No Overall divider, custom bar ticks

```{r}
#| echo: false
table1viz(
  df_miss,
  name_groupvar = "grp",
  overall_divider = FALSE,
  bar_axis = TRUE,
  bar_axis_breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100)
)
```
